2-401.11
Food employees must eat, drink and use tobacco in designated areas.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: An employee shall eat, drink, or use any form of tobacco only in designated areas where the contamination of exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; unwrapped single-service and single-use articles; or other items needing protection can not result.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Today half of a wrapped burrito was observed resting on top of cans of soda in the walk-in. An employee shall eat, drink, or use any form of tobacco only in designated areas where the contamination of exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; unwrapped single-service and single-use articles; or other items needing protection can not result. Correct within 3 days by re-educating staff and having a designated section for employee food items that do not risk contamination.
